$comment: An example contracts/native-libraries.json: one library kept on the interop layer, one being replaced.

react-native-legacy-picker.reason: The due-date wheel picker; no New Architecture picker matches its accessibility yet
react-native-legacy-picker.evidence: React Native Directory: newArchitecture false (2026-10-14). Due-date screen tested on the iOS 26.5 simulator and an Android 16 emulator: VoiceOver and TalkBack read every wheel; no interop warning in Metro

react-native-old-share.reason: Shares the exported task list file (a local CSV file URI) through the system share sheet; expo-sharing covers it (plain text would go through React Native's built-in Share API)
react-native-old-share.evidence: Library archived on GitHub (2026-08); no release since the New Architecture became the only one
